# DOCX regression fixtures

Moved out of the Viewer public directory so test documents are not included in web releases or Android assets.

- `behavior.docx`: paragraph and pagination behavior.
- `font.docx`: embedded font; also used by the large-media fixture generator.
- `image.docx`: inline image used by the large XML fixture generator.
- `table.docx`: revisions, footnotes, merged and nested tables.
